raw_text: First anniversary of Mahsa Amini's death. Protests beginning in Tehran, Isfahan, and Sanandaj despite massive security presence. Basij forces deployed in all major squares. Internet speeds throttled across Iran. Kurdish regions under heavy surveillance. Woman Life Freedom movement remains alive.
